contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONST[ANTI]VS PP AVG ; R/ FEL TEMP REPARATIO

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of Constantius II (323-361), probably an irregular fallen horseman issue of 355-361 with retrograde image and legend on reverse. These unusual characteristics - even for an irregular coin - may commend it as a find of note. Obverse description: Bust draped, diademed and cuirassed right; armour rendered by a few strong lines. Obverse inscription: CONST[ANTI]VS PP AVG. Reverse description: Soldier advancing right spearing fallen horseman; horseman may have helmet with crest. Reverse inscription: FEL TEMP REPARATIO retrograde, letters as well as their order are reversed. Diameter: 15.7mm, Weight: 1.01gms, die axis: 6
